documentation.title: Format Support
documentation.standard:
Listing commands (list, get, search, index, show, status, info, report) should print through WP_CLI\Utils\format_items() and honor --format, so scripts get table, json, csv or yaml output. Same-class helpers are followed; declare work done in another class with "@cli-standards format-delegated <reason>".
Requirement: C3 (SHOULD, warning). Error codes: MissingFormatSupport. Properties: ignoreMethods (method names that are never commands), ignoreClasses (classes that are never command classes).
